description: Répertoire des actions/solutions de la feuille de route Transition écologique et énergétique - Orléans Métropole is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data Orléans Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Orléans Métropole. Répertoire des actions/solutions de la feuille de route transition écologique et énergétique, issues des Assises de la transition d'Orléans Métropole (2021). Les thèmes de ce répertoire, repris dans le manifeste en faveur de la transition écologique voté en avril 2022, sont disponibles ici:. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The portal files it under Environnement, Transition écologique. The portal shows 308 records. The portal shows 2022-04-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-orleans-metropole-fr-portal.
